Build a single self-contained HTML file at `/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/mnt/outputs/interactive-mockup.html` that is an interactive design mockup of the IB Resume BA tool.

## WHAT THIS IS
An interactive mockup where each page of the resume tool is a tab at the top, and a floating control panel lets you change design elements (fonts, colors, radius, etc.) across the entire mockup in real-time. When you pick a different heading font, it changes right there in the mockup.

## PAGES (TABS)
Build these 5 page tabs, each as a full-page mockup:

### Tab 1: "Landing / Access Code"
- Top: scrolling bank ticker bar (GOLDMAN SACHS, J.P. MORGAN, MORGAN STANLEY, BANK OF AMERICA, CITI, BARCLAYS, EVERCORE, LAZARD, MOELIS, PJT PARTNERS, ROTHSCHILD)
- Left side: "~ PRIVATE ACCESS ONLY ~" label, big heading "Built for IB recruiting." with italic "Unfiltered." below in accent font, subtitle text, stats row (18+ BANK PROFILES, 14+ FORMAT CHECKS, 100 POINT SCORE)
- Right side: Card with "INVITE ONLY" label, "Enter your access code" heading, subtitle, ACCESS CODE input field (placeholder: IBROS-2026), EMAIL input field (placeholder: candidate@university.edu), gold "Continue →" button, footer text about banks

### Tab 2: "Upload Resume"
- Top nav: "IB Resume BA" logo left, 3-step progress indicator right (step 1 active)
- "STEP 1 OF 3" label, "Upload your resume" serif heading, subtitle text
- Gold-dashed border upload zone with upload icon, "Drop your resume here", "PDF or DOCX - max 10MB", "or click to browse"
- Back / Continue buttons

### Tab 3: "About You"
- Same nav with step 2 active
- "STEP 2 OF 3", "About you" serif heading, subtitle
- Form: School input, Graduation Year dropdown (2026), Target Geography dropdown (United States), Role Type dropdown (Summer internship on-cycle), Target Group input (optional)
- Back / Continue buttons

### Tab 4: "Target Banks"
- Same nav with step 3 active
- "STEP 3 OF 3", "Target banks" serif heading, subtitle
- Mode toggle: PICK BANKS / ENTIRE TIERS
- Bank tier tabs: Elite Boutique (active), Boutique, Bulge Bracket, Middle Market
- Bank pills: Evercore, Lazard, Centerview, Moelis, PJT Partners, Rothschild
- Search bar with ADD button
- Back / "Analyze my resume →" gold button

### Tab 5: "Results"
The most complex page. Two-column layout:

**Left column (main):**
- Score card: green circle with "95" / 100, "INTERVIEW-READY" badge, "Your resume is highly competitive for top IB roles." heading, subtitle
- Category progress bars: FORMAT 15/15, EDUCATION 15/15, EXPERIENCE 30/30, BULLETS 20/25, POSITIONING 15/15
- CRITICAL FIXES section: "1 ISSUE" red badge, WARNING card with orange border — "Enhance Bullet Specificity and Outcomes", description text, FROM YOUR RESUME quote box, BEFORE → AFTER comparison (strikethrough old, green new)
- IB FORMAT CHECKLIST: "13/13 PASSED" green badge, list of items (Layout, Section order, Dates present, Date alignment, Date format, Bullet tense, Punctuation, GPA displayed, Contact info, No objective/summary, Interests line, Relevant coursework, Font & sizing) each with green check + "Pass" badge
- BULLET REWRITER section: Original vs IB-Optimized pairs

**Right column (sidebar):**
- BANK FIT ANALYSIS card: "Evercore" with green dot + "Strong" green badge, description
- BANK-SPECIFIC INTEL card: "EVERCORE" heading, "THEY LOOK FOR:" bullet list, "HOW TO POSITION:" bullet list
- YOUR RECRUITING TIMELINE card: 3 date ranges (Now-Mar 2026, Apr-Jun 2026, Jul-Sep 2026) with descriptions
- HONEST ASSESSMENT card: paragraph of text

## FLOATING CONTROL PANEL
A draggable floating panel (bottom-right by default, ~300px wide) with:
- Collapse/expand toggle
- Title: "Design Controls"

Each control is a labeled dropdown/button-group with 8 options:

### Controls to include:
1. **Heading Font** — Options: Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, Libre Baskerville, Lora, DM Sans, IBM Plex Sans, Space Grotesk, Inter
2. **Body Font** — Options: Inter, IBM Plex Sans, DM Sans, Space Grotesk, Helvetica Neue, Source Sans Pro, system-ui, Libre Franklin
3. **Mono Font** — Options: DM Mono, JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, Fira Code, Inconsolata, IBM Plex Mono, Roboto Mono, Courier New
4. **Accent/Gold Color** — Options: #C9A96E (current gold), #D4A853 (warm gold), #B8860B (dark gold), #C0C0C0 (silver), #E8D5B7 (champagne), #8B7355 (muted bronze), #D4AF37 (metallic gold), #A0522D (sienna)
5. **Background Color** — Options: #0A0A0A (current), #050505 (true black), #000000 (pure black), #0C0A09 (warm black), #111111 (neutral gray), #0F0E0C (warm charcoal), #0D0B08 (deep brown), #0E1014 (dark slate)
6. **Card Background** — Options: #141312 (current), #0F0F0F, #1A1A1A, #12110F, #161616, #0D0D0D, #181614, #1C1C1C
7. **Text Color** — Options: #F5F5F5 (current), #E8E8E8, #FFFFFF, #D4D0C8 (warm), #B5B0A8 (stone), #CCCCCC, #E0DDD5, #F0EBE3
8. **Secondary Text** — Options: #888888, #777777, #666666, #999999, #7A7A7A, #8B8680, #9A9590, #6B6B6B
9. **Border Radius** — Options: 12px (current), 8px, 6px, 4px, 2px, 0px, 16px, 3px
10. **Button Style** — Options: Gold filled, Gold outline, White filled, Dark filled, Gold gradient, Minimal underline, Pill shape, Sharp rectangle
11. **Progress Bar Style** — Options: Green gradient (current), Solid green, Gold accent, Thin line, Segmented, Rounded pill, Flat gray+green, Striped
12. **Score Circle Style** — Options: Green ring (current), Large mono number, Gold ring, Thin ring, Donut chart, Square badge, Serif number, Gradient ring
13. **Badge Style** — Options: Colored pill (current), Outlined pill, Square tag, Text only, Dot + text, Underline accent, Filled rectangle, Minimal chip
14. **Issue Card Border** — Options: Left colored bar (current), Full border, Top accent line, Dashed border, Shadow only, Glow effect, Corner accent, Double line

## TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
- Single self-contained HTML file (inline CSS + JS)
- Load Google Fonts: Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, Libre Baskerville, Lora, DM Sans, IBM Plex Sans, Space Grotesk, Inter, DM Mono, JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, Fira Code, Inconsolata
- Use CSS custom properties (variables) for ALL themeable values — the controls update CSS variables on :root
- The floating panel should be draggable by its header
- Each control should be a `<select>` dropdown for space efficiency
- Changes apply instantly (no save button needed)
- Mobile responsive — panel becomes a bottom sheet on mobile
- The whole thing should look polished and professional
- Default values should match the current site design

## CURRENT SITE DESIGN VALUES
- Body bg: rgb(10, 10, 10) / #0A0A0A
- Card bg: rgb(20, 19, 18) / #141312
- Body font: Inter
- Heading font: Playfair Display
- Accent/gold: rgb(201, 169, 110) / #C9A96E
- Text: rgb(245, 245, 245) / #F5F5F5
- Secondary text: rgb(136, 136, 136) / #888
- Green: rgb(46, 204, 113) / #2ECC71
- Red/warning: rgb(231, 76, 60) / #E74C3C
- Orange: rgb(243, 156, 18) / #F39C12
- Border radius: 12px
- Pass badge bg: rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.12) with green text
- Warning badge bg: rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.12) with red text

## IMPORTANT
- Make EVERY piece of text realistic — use the actual content from the tool
- The mockup should look nearly identical to the real site with default settings
- When you change a control, the change should be visually obvious and affect ALL relevant elements across ALL tabs
- Write the complete file — this is the primary deliverable. Make it comprehensive and polished.
- The file will likely be 2000+ lines. That's fine. Write the whole thing.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>IB Resume BA Tool - Interactive Mockup</title>

    <!-- Google Fonts -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Libre+Baskerville:wght@400;700&family=Lora:wght@400;500;600;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Source+Code+Pro:wght@400;500&family=Fira+Code:wght@400;500&family=Inconsolata:wght@400;700&family=Roboto+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <style>
        /* CSS Custom Properties for Theming */
        :root {
            /* Fonts */
            --heading-font: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            --body-font: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            --mono-font: 'DM Mono', monospace;

            /* Colors */
            --accent-gold: #C9A96E;
            --bg-body: #0A0A0A;
            --bg-card: #141312;
            --text-primary: #F5F5F5;
            --text-secondary: #888888;
            --color-green: #2ECC71;
            --color-red: #E74C3C;
            --color-orange: #F39C12;

            /* Spacing & Design */
            --border-radius: 12px;

            /* Button Style: gold-filled, gold-outline, white-filled, dark-filled, gold-gradient, minimal-underline, pill-shape, sharp-rectangle */
            --button-style: gold-filled;

            /* Progress Bar Style: green-gradient, solid-green, gold-accent, thin-line, segmented, rounded-pill, flat-gray-green, striped */
            --progress-style: green-gradient;

            /* Score Circle Style: green-ring, large-mono, gold-ring, thin-ring, donut, square-badge, serif-number, gradient-ring */
            --score-style: green-ring;

            /* Badge Style: colored-pill, outlined-pill, square-tag, text-only, dot-text, underline-accent, filled-rect, minimal-chip */
            --badge-style: colored-pill;

            /* Issue Card Border: left-bar, full-border, top-line, dashed-border, shadow-only, glow, corner-accent, double-line */
            --issue-border-style: left-bar;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            background-color: var(--bg-body);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-family: var(--body-font);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* Layout */
        .container {
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .tab-navigation {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1px;
            background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            padding: 0.5rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            overflow-x: auto;
        }

        .tab-btn {
            padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-family: var(--body-font);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .tab-btn.active {
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent-gold);
            background-color: rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.08);
        }

        .tab-btn:hover:not(.active) {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .tab-content {
            display: none;
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .tab-content.active {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        /* Tab 1: Landing / Access Code */
        .ticker-bar {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--bg-card), var(--bg-body));
            padding: 0.75rem 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.3);
        }

        .ticker-content {
            display: flex;
            gap: 3rem;
            animation: scroll-ticker 30s linear infinite;
        }

        .ticker-item {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        @keyframes scroll-ticker {
            0% { transform: translateX(0); }
            100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
        }

        .landing-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 3rem;
            padding: 4rem;
            flex: 1;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .landing-left h1 {
            font-family: var(--heading-font);
            font-size: 3.5rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .landing-left .italic-accent {
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            display: block;
        }

        .landing-left > p {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            max-width: 500px;
        }

        .landing-stats {
            display: flex;
            gap: 2rem;
            margin-top: 2rem;
        }

        .stat-item {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        .access-card {
            background-color: var(--bg-card);
            padding: 3rem;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            border: 1px solid rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.3);
        }

        .access-card-label {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .access-card h2 {
            font-family: var(--heading-font);
            font-size: 1.8rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        .access-card > p {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
        }

        .form-group {
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .form-label {
            display: block;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        input[type="text"],
        input[type="email"],
        select {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
            background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.2);
            border-radius: calc(var(--border-radius) / 2);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-family: var(--body-font);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
        }

        input[type="text"]::placeholder,
        input[type="email"]::placeholder {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        input[type="text"]:focus,
        input[type="email"]:focus,
        select:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--accent-gold);
            background-color: rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.08);
        }

        .access-card .footer-text {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 2rem;
            padding-top: 2rem;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.1);
        }

        /* Buttons */
        .btn {
            padding: 0.85rem 2rem;
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            font-family: var(--body-font);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background-color: var(--accent-gold);
            color: var(--bg-body);
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            opacity: 0.9;
            transform: translateX(4px);
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            background-color: transparent;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent-gold);
            color: var(--accent-gold);
        }

        /* Tab 2: Upload Resume */
        .step-container {
            padding: 4rem;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .nav-bar {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            background-color: var(--bg-card);
        }

        .nav-logo {
            font-family: var(--heading-font);
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-gold);
        }

        .step-indicator {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1.5rem;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .step {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .step-number {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background-color: rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.2);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .step.active .step-number {
            background-color: var(--accent-gold);
            color: var(--bg-body);
        }

        .step-label {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .step.active .step-label {
            color: var(--accent-gold);
        }

        .step-header {
            margin-bottom: 3rem;
        }

        .step-header .step-number-text {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .step-header h1 {
            font-family: var(--heading-font);
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        .step-header > p {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            max-width: 600px;
        }

        .upload-zone {
            border: 2px dashed var(--accent-gold);
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            padding: 4rem;
            text-align: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            margin: 2rem 0;
        }

        .upload-zone:hover {
            background-color: rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.08);
        }

        .upload-icon {
            font-size: 3rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .upload-zone p {
            margin: 0.5rem 0;
        }

        .upload-zone .main-text {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .upload-zone .sub-text {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        .button-group {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin-top: 3rem;
        }

        .button-group .btn {
            flex: 1;
        }

        /* Tab 3: About You */
        .form-container {
            max-width: 600px;
        }

        .form-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 1.5rem;
            margin: 2rem 0;
        }

        .form-grid.full {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }

        /* Tab 4: Target Banks */
        .banks-container {
            max-width: 800px;
        }

        .mode-toggle {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin: 2rem 0;
            background-color: var(--bg-card);
            padding: 0.5rem;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            width: fit-content;
        }

        .mode-btn {
            padding: 0.6rem 1.5rem;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-family: var(--body-font);
            font-weight: 600;
            border-radius: calc(var(--border-radius) / 2);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .mode-btn.active {
            background-color: rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.2);
            color: var(--accent-gold);
        }

        .tier-tabs {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin: 2rem 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            overflow-x: auto;
        }

        .tier-tab {
            padding: 1rem;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-family: var(--body-font);
            font-weight: 600;
            border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .tier-tab.active {
            color: var(--accent-gold);
            border-bottom-color: var(--accent-gold);
        }

        .bank-pills {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin: 2rem 0;
        }

        .bank-pill {
            padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
            background-color: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.3);
            border-radius: 20px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .bank-pill:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent-gold);
            background-color: rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.1);
        }

        .bank-pill.selected {
            background-color: rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.2);
            border-color: var(--accent-gold);
            color: var(--accent-gold);
        }

        .search-add {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin: 2rem 0;
        }

        }

        .search-add .btn {
            flex: 0 0 auto;

        .results-layout {

        }

        .score-circle {

        .score-number {
            font-family: var(--heading-font);

        }

        .score-info > p {

            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .category-bars {
            margin-top: 2rem;

            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .category-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            font-size: 0.9rem;

        // ==================== DRAGGABLE CONTROL PANEL ====================

        let isDragging = false;
        let offset = { x: 0, y: 0 };

        controlHeader.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
            isDragging = true;
            const rect = controlPanel.getBoundingClientRect();
            offset.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
            offset.y = e.clientY - rect.top;
        });

        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            if (isDragging) {
                controlPanel.style.bottom = 'auto';
                controlPanel.style.right = 'auto';
                controlPanel.style.top = (e.clientY - offset.y) + 'px';
                controlPanel.style.left = (e.clientX - offset.x) + 'px';
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
            isDragging = false;
        });

        collapseBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            controlPanel.classList.toggle('collapsed');
            collapseBtn.textContent = controlPanel.classList.contains('collapsed') ? '+' : '−';
        });

        // ==================== TAB NAVIGATION ====================
        const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');
        const tabContents = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content');

        tabButtons.forEach(button => {
            button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const tabId = button.getAttribute('data-tab');

                // Remove active class from all tabs and buttons
                tabButtons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
                tabContents.forEach(content => content.classList.remove('active'));

                // Add active class to clicked button and corresponding tab
                button.classList.add('active');
                document.getElementById(tabId).classList.add('active');
            });
        });

        // ==================== DESIGN CONTROL HANDLERS ====================

        // ==================== STYLE APPLICATION FUNCTIONS ====================
        function applyButtonStyles(style) {
            const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.btn-primary');
            btns.forEach(btn => {
                // Reset classes
                btn.classList.remove('gold-outline', 'white-filled', 'dark-filled', 'gradient');

                if (style === 'gold-outline') {
                    btn.style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                    btn.style.border = '2px solid var(--accent-gold)';
                    btn.style.color = 'var(--accent-gold)';
                } else if (style === 'white-filled') {
                    btn.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--text-primary)';
                    btn.style.border = 'none';
                    btn.style.color = 'var(--bg-body)';
                } else if (style === 'dark-filled') {
                    btn.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
                    btn.style.border = 'none';
                    btn.style.color = 'var(--text-primary)';
                } else if (style === 'gold-gradient') {

                    btn.style.border = 'none';
                    btn.style.color = 'var(--bg-body)';

                    btn.style.border = 'none';
                    btn.style.borderBottom = '2px solid var(--accent-gold)';
                    btn.style.color = 'var(--accent-gold)';
                    btn.style.borderRadius = '0';

                    btn.style.border = 'none';
                    btn.style.color = 'var(--bg-body)';
                    btn.style.borderRadius = '50px';

                    btn.style.border = 'none';
                    btn.style.color = 'var(--bg-body)';
                    btn.style.borderRadius = '0';

                    btn.style.border = 'none';
                    btn.style.color = 'var(--bg-body)';
                    btn.style.borderRadius = 'var(--border-radius)';

                } else if (style === 'square-tag') {
                    badge.style.borderRadius = 'var(--border-radius)';
                } else if (style === 'text-only') {
                    badge.style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                    badge.style.padding = '0';
                } else if (style === 'dot-text') {
                    badge.style.paddingLeft = '0.4rem';
                } else if (style === 'underline-accent') {
                    badge.style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                    badge.style.borderBottom = '2px solid currentColor';
                    badge.style.borderRadius = '0';
                } else if (style === 'filled-rect') {
                    badge.style.borderRadius = '2px';
                } else if (style === 'minimal-chip') {
                    badge.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(201,169,110,0.1)';
                    badge.style.padding = '0.3rem 0.6rem';
                } else {
                    // colored-pill (default)
                    badge.style.borderRadius = '12px';
                    badge.style.border = 'none';
                }
            });
        }

        function applyIssueCardStyles(style) {
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.issue-card');
            cards.forEach(card => {
                // Reset styles
                card.style.borderLeft = 'none';
                card.style.border = 'none';
                card.style.borderTop = 'none';
                card.style.boxShadow = 'none';
                card.style.position = 'relative';

                if (style === 'full-border') {
                    card.style.border = '2px solid var(--color-orange)';
                } else if (style === 'top-line') {
                    card.style.borderTop = '4px solid var(--color-orange)';
                    card.style.border = 'none';
                } else if (style === 'dashed-border') {
                    card.style.border = '2px dashed var(--color-orange)';
                } else if (style === 'shadow-only') {
                    card.style.boxShadow = '0 0 20px rgba(243,156,18,0.2)';
                } else if (style === 'glow') {
                    card.style.boxShadow = '0 0 30px rgba(243,156,18,0.4), inset 0 0 20px rgba(243,156,18,0.1)';
                    card.style.border = 'none';
                } else if (style === 'corner-accent') {
                    card.style.border = '1px solid rgba(243,156,18,0.3)';
                    card.style.borderRadius = 'var(--border-radius)';
                    card.style.position = 'relative';
                    // Would need pseudo-element for true corner accent
                } else if (style === 'double-line') {
                    card.style.borderLeft = '4px double var(--color-orange)';
                } else {
                    // left-bar (default)
                    card.style.borderLeft = '4px solid var(--color-orange)';
                }
            });
        }

        // Initialize styles on load
        applyButtonStyles('gold-filled');
        applyProgressStyles('green-gradient');
        applyScoreStyles('green-ring');
        applyBadgeStyles('colored-pill');
        applyIssueCardStyles('left-bar');
    </script>
</body>
</html>
